title: Fixed Open-Wing Laundry Drying Rack
description: One complete original static winged laundry drying rack. Two whole U-shaped sheared standing frames cross on real transverse pins with finite bottom soles. A continuous open rectangular central frame carries separated drying rods; two complete raised side-wing frames have full rods, transverse hinge pins and fixed diagonal props. All parts authored together as one new model; not a clothesline with altered rod count, a three-tier shelf, or an ironing board with its solid deck removed. No clothes, folding animation, hinge clearance, drying rate, load, stability, ergonomics or safety certification.
